sentiment: The work is allowed to be a pleasure. What is carried gently into a new home can still grow back its light.

stories.title: It's still ok to enjoy programming
stories.summary: A quiet case that delight is reason enough — that the pleasure of making is not a distraction from the work but a signal it is going well.

stories.title: Wine ported to OpenBSD
stories.summary: Software carefully lifted out of one system and settled into another — an old thing finding a new home and working again.

stories.title: Restoration of Retinal Regenerative Potential
stories.summary: Researchers coaxing light-sensing cells to regrow what was thought lost — evidence that some endings are only a pause.
